intro.text: A bird found mainly in Shinovar. The Thaylen trademaster Vstim buys chickens from the Shin and sells them in the east at high prices.

description.text: Chicken is eaten in Shinovar and exported east. In the Vorin nations it is an uncommon dish, fit even for a royal feast.
Adolin Kholin counts chicken as lucky food and makes a point of eating some before every duel.
Geese live wild in the Horneater Peaks, so Unkalaki arrows are often fletched with their feathers, and the Unkalaki language has its own word for goose.
Most easterners know little about how chickens look or behave. Even as more people learn to tell different birds apart, "chicken" stays the everyday Vorin word for them.

items.text: At the Middlefest Fair a Thaylen merchant showed Jeksonofnone, a bright green chicken that said its own name on command.
At the menagerie on the Shattered Plains, Shallan saw a "chicken" with red, blue and green feathers while out with Adolin and Kaladin.
